zh: assessment objective：判定某控制是否有效的目标句，本文件的程序按它编号。
determination statement：把评估目标细分到控制条目或组织定义参数的可判定短句。
assessment method：界定评估者动作性质的方法，本文件为 examine、interview 与 test 三种。
assessment object：被评估的具体项目，含 specifications、mechanisms、activities 与 individuals。
depth / coverage：分别刻画评估的严格程度与范围的属性，取值 basic、focused、comprehensive。
assurance case：组织成论证以证明某项关于系统的断言成立的证据体。
en: Assessment objective: the statement of what must be determined about a control, by which the procedures are numbered.
Determination statement: a short decidable clause granularising an assessment objective by control item or parameter.
Assessment method: the nature of assessor actions, here examine, interview and test.
Assessment object: the specific item assessed, among specifications, mechanisms, activities and individuals.
Depth / coverage: the attributes setting rigour and scope of an assessment, valued basic, focused or comprehensive.
Assurance case: evidence organised into an argument that some claim about a system holds.
